# ShelfReady

> ShelfReady is an iPhone app for people who sell things. Take a photo of an item, and the app removes the background and sets the item on a clean studio backdrop with a soft shadow, sized for your listing. Photos are edited on the device and never uploaded.

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18.0 or later. No Android or web version.
- Price model: free to download. The first 3 saves are free; unlimited saving and sharing, saving a batch of photos at once and no ads come with a weekly or monthly subscription, or a yearly plan or one-time lifetime purchase offered in the app.
- Made by Visto Apps, the brand of Darius Cirjan: https://vistoapps.com (more apps: https://vistoapps.com/apps.html)
- Contact: iosallapps@gmail.com
